description: Preranked gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA; Subramanian et al. 2005) with fgsea's multilevel p-values (Korotkevich et al.), either as clusterProfiler's GSEA() runs it (enrichit 0.2.6, with q-values; or its fixed-count or adaptive sample and permute tests) or as fgsea 1.38 itself runs it (fgseaMultilevel, or fgseaSimple with a permutation count): weighted running-sum enrichment score, normalized ES against size-matched permutations, multilevel Monte Carlo p-values down to eps, adjusted p, log2err, rank at maximum, leading-edge genes. Seeded: a seed reproduces the chosen package's p-values exactly, and every set is bit-identical to that package in R on pasilla's DESeq2 Wald statistics against every fly GO term.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

adaptive.description: sample or permute: draw per set in batches from minPerm, doubling while its p-value is at most pvalThreshold, up to maxPerm, instead of a fixed count. Only applies when method is sample or permute.

engine.description: clusterProfiler: enrichit 0.2.6's GSEA, what clusterProfiler 4.20's GSEA() runs, with q-values. fgsea: fgsea 1.38's own, a different random stream and arithmetic, so the same seed gives fgsea's p-values; BH only, no q-value.

eps.description: floor for multilevel p-values; 0 estimates them however small. Only applies when method is multilevel.

exponent.description: weight of each gene's statistic in the running sum: 0 is the unweighted Kolmogorov-Smirnov form, 1 classic GSEA.

geneSets.description: the gene sets, as GMT text (MSigDB, GO or WikiPathways exports): one set per line, tab-separated ID, description, then member gene IDs. IDs must be the same kind as the genes'.

maxGSSize.description: largest set tested, counted among the ranked genes.

maxPerm.description: adaptive: the most draws any set gets. Only applies when adaptive is true.

method.description: clusterProfiler's p-value: multilevel Monte Carlo (fgsea-derived, down to eps); sample: a fixed count of random gene samples of each set's size; permute: that count of relabellings of the whole ranked list (slower: every set is re-scored along every permuted list). The permutation methods score both tails whatever the score type. Only applies when engine is clusterProfiler.

minGSSize.description: smallest set tested, counted among the ranked genes.

minPerm.description: adaptive: the first batch for every set. Only applies when adaptive is true.

nPermSimple.description: multilevel: permutations for the first, simple p-value estimate and the NES. Only applies when method is multilevel.

nperm.description: fgsea: run fgseaSimple with this many permutations (p-values no smaller than 1/(nperm + 1)); 0 keeps the multilevel estimate. Only applies when engine is fgsea.

pAdjustMethod.description: multiple-testing adjustment across the tested sets (R `p.adjust`).

permutations.description: sample or permute: null draws per set (p-values no smaller than 1/(same-side draws + 1)). Only applies when method is sample or permute.

pvalThreshold.description: adaptive: a set whose p-value rises above this stops drawing. Only applies when adaptive is true.

pvalueCutoff.description: a set is significant when p and adjusted p are at most this.

ranked.description: the ranked list: 'gene statistic' per line (tab, comma or space), e.g. a DE run's Wald statistic; sorted decreasing here if it is not.

sampleSize.description: multilevel samples per level (made odd). Only applies when method is multilevel.

scoreType.description: std: both tails; pos or neg: one-tailed, for a statistic with one meaningful sign (the multilevel estimate only). Only applies when method is multilevel.

seed.description: seeds the permutations; the same seed gives the same p-values as the chosen engine in R (fgsea: set.seed(seed) before the call).

name: gene_set_enrichment

enriched.description: the sets passing the p and adjusted-p cutoff

runningScore.description: the running enrichment score along the ranked list for the top set, with its hits

summary.description: ranked genes, ties, whether the list was re-sorted, sets supplied and in range, significant sets, q-value route

terms.description: every set in the size range, by |NES|: ES, NES, p, adjusted p, q-value, log2err, rank at maximum, leading-edge statistics and genes, and the ranks of the set's members
